test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which of the following articles, "Culture and Educational Rights" are mentioned?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 29 - 30.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 29-30 **of the Indian Constitution mention **"Culture and Educational Rights".**
 
• "Culture and Educational Rights" are an important aspect of the Indian Constitution that provide for the** right to conserve and promote one's own culture** and also provide for the **right to education.**​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 25-28** deal with** "Freedom of Religion".**
 
• **Article 23-24 **mention **"Prohibition of Traffic in Human Beings and Forced Labour".**
 
• **Article 19-22** deal with **"Protection of Certain Rights regarding Freedom of Speech, etc.". **
